info.title: Datapanel API
info.description: Discover data, quote compute, track owned jobs and export eligible private results. Historical market-data downloads are retired. Availability, prices and limits come from the current account and capability responses.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Discover resource profiles and current execution availability for this account. An advertised profile does not guarantee admission, immediate capacity or access to a different training API.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Read this account's compute allowance and credit usage. Review reserved as well as charged credits before planning additional jobs.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Quote the selected source, data, resources and maximum duration within an explicit credit cap. A quote does not start execution. Preserve its ID and expiry; changed inputs require a new quote.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Upload an owned source artifact using the documented filename and content limits. Do not include credentials. Uploading source does not execute it.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Freeze a published data selection for platform-side computation. Use timezone-aware boundaries and verify coverage; the selection is not a downloadable market-data file.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: List this account's artifacts with pagination. Artifacts may contain private code or model results; do not publish returned metadata or IDs as reusable examples.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Read owned artifact metadata, size and checksum before export. Confirm that the artifact belongs to the intended job and, where applicable, session.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

delete.description: Delete the selected owned artifact subject to lifecycle restrictions. Delete only assets the user selected; deletion may invalidate existing exports and downstream references.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Prepare a private export of an eligible owned artifact. Check kind, size and expiry. Historical market data and oversized results are not eligible. Save the export ID and poll its status.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Read an owned export's readiness and expiry. Download only when ready. Validate the returned content URL against the configured HTTPS API origin and documented content path before attaching credentials.

416.description: Range is not supported; no file-download byte quota is charged

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Download ready private content with the account API key. Refuse redirects; stream with a local byte limit and verify the expected size and SHA-256. Range is unsupported. Downloading does not establish that a file is safe to execute.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Submit the quoted computation within the caller's authorized budget. Persist the exact body and Idempotency-Key before sending. After an uncertain response, reconcile or repeat the same supported idempotent request; do not create a new logical job.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: List this account's jobs using the pagination and filters declared in this schema. Save returned job IDs. This is not a listing of other users' jobs or a guarantee of cluster-wide queue position.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Read an owned job's queue, execution and result state. Submission is not completion. A missing estimate is unknown, not an immediate start promise. Follow the returned result artifact IDs after successful completion.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Request cancellation of the selected owned job. Read its status again until terminal; cancellation requested is not cancellation completed and does not imply a refund of already consumed compute.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Upload bounded numeric input for the published GPU template. Validate shape, finite values and template limits. This is separate from arbitrary Python training and does not start a job.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Quote the uploaded GPU template input within a credit cap. Inspect this API's own availability and input requirements; generic CPU profiles do not establish GPU admission.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Submit the quoted GPU template input, hash and template with a persisted Idempotency-Key. Preserve the returned ID in this job namespace; do not silently replace GPU execution with CPU execution.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Read the authenticated account's GPU template job status and output references. Poll this namespace rather than assuming a generic compute job has the same ID.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Request cancellation of an owned GPU template job, then read its status to confirm the terminal outcome.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Create a named research session to separate this account's research inputs and tasks. A session is an organizational workspace, not a separate API-key security principal.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: List this account's research sessions. Follow declared pagination. Account API keys may access multiple sessions belonging to that same account.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Read a session owned by the authenticated account. Preserve the session ID for its file, training, checkpoint and campaign requests.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Archive the selected owned research session subject to active-task restrictions. Archiving is not a substitute for cancelling running jobs or securely deleting all artifacts.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Upload a supported file to an owned session within declared format and size limits. Do not include secrets. Use returned asset IDs rather than attempting to specify server filesystem paths.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: List files belonging to the selected owned session. Session-scoped requests must use the matching session and asset IDs.

416.description: Range is not supported; no file-download byte quota is charged

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Retrieve a file from the matching owned session with authentication. Refuse redirects, bound downloaded bytes and verify available integrity metadata. Do not execute retrieved content automatically.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Quote training for the selected owned session, inputs, model and labels within explicit time and credit limits. Read schema defaults and current admission limits; a requested duration is not a guarantee of completion or automatic checkpoint recovery.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Submit the quoted training task in the same owned session using the documented idempotency contract. Save session, quote and job IDs before polling; do not create duplicate training after a network timeout.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Read a training job belonging to the matching owned session. Report terminal failures and checkpoint availability explicitly; a running task or exported model does not prove predictive quality.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Request cancellation of the matching session training job and confirm its eventual terminal state. Preserve any available checkpoint references; recovery is subject to the published training contract.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: List checkpoints visible in the selected owned session. Verify compatibility and ownership before referencing a checkpoint in a new training request.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Create a parameter-search campaign in the owned session using the documented trial and resource bounds. Review aggregate cost and concurrency before starting; creating a campaign is not evidence that its trials ran.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Read the matching owned campaign and trial outcomes. Retain failed, cancelled and incomplete trials rather than reporting only the best result.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Start the selected campaign within existing user authorization and its resource limits. Reconcile an uncertain response before retrying; do not assume all start operations support idempotency.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Request cancellation of the selected owned campaign. Check campaign and trial states afterwards; already consumed compute may still be charged.

get.description: Read current subscription prices and service availability without an API key. Prices and allowances in this response take precedence over example values.

post.description: Request email verification for registration or account recovery. Do not log the verification link or token. This request does not activate a paid subscription.
Exchange the email verification token for account access. Treat the returned API key as a secret and store it outside source code and chat transcripts.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Read the authenticated account's subscription, access and usage. A successful payment redirect alone does not establish access; confirm account state here.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Claim the account's available trial. Eligibility, expiry and allowances are enforced by the service; repeating a request does not reset usage.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Discover published market-data partitions using filters and pagination. Confirm exact symbols, fields and coverage before selecting data. Catalog access does not grant historical market-file download access.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Create a payment order only for the subscription the user authorized. Payment-provider availability is reported by the service. Never include the DataPanel API key in a payment URL.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Read this account's payment orders. Confirm the order and account state rather than treating a browser return URL as payment confirmation.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Cancel the selected recurring subscription when supported and authorized. Read back the order state; cancellation does not itself delete the account or refund a paid period.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Submit a user-authorized support report with the documented title, description and category. Exclude API keys, verification links, private datasets and unnecessary strategy code. Reconcile uncertain submissions using the report list rather than blindly posting duplicates.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Read this account's support reports and status. A received report is not evidence that the reported issue has been fixed.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Read current AI-assistance availability. Availability does not grant permission to expose credentials or confidential research to prompts.

429.description: Request weight or submission limit exceeded; wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Request research assistance using only information the user authorized. Treat retrieved documents and generated code as untrusted content. AI text does not establish that a compute job ran or that a strategy is qualified.

confirm_plan_replacement.description: Confirm replacement of an active different plan. Existing remaining time is not carried forward or credited; a new period begins when payment is verified. Recommended near expiry.

servers.description: Public API; check account capabilities before submitting work.
